title: How many slides went into the model?
subtitle: Whole-slide images used for pretraining, log scale. Peer-reviewed except where noted.

items.label: CHIEF (2024)
items.detail: 60,530 WSIs across 19 anatomic sites; tile-level self-supervision plus weakly supervised slide-level pretraining.

items.label: UNI (2024)
items.detail: More than 100 million images from over 100,000 H&E WSIs across 20 major tissue types.

items.label: Prov-GigaPath (2024)
items.detail: 1.3 billion 256×256 tiles from 171,189 slides at Providence; LongNet slide encoder.

items.label: TITAN (2025)
items.detail: 335,645 WSIs plus pathology reports and 423,122 synthetic captions.

items.label: Virchow (2024)
items.detail: About 1.5 million H&E WSIs from roughly 100,000 patients at Memorial Sloan Kettering.

items.label: Virchow2 (2024 preprint)
items.detail: About 3.1 million WSIs, reported in a preprint.
